measurement.topology: Windows server worker + separate Node load-generator process + isolated Docker PostgreSQL
measurement.transport: loopback HTTP + WebSocket, health:true, idleSnapshots per settings, no TLS or reverse proxy
measurement.tcpBytes: server HTTP net.Socket.bytesWritten including WebSocket/Engine.IO/Socket.IO framing; excludes IP/TCP headers, retransmissions, TLS and DB traffic; not provider-billed egress
measurement.jsonBytes: sum of JSON.stringify(snapshot) UTF-8 bytes received by all peers
measurement.authLookups: Prisma deviceIdentity.findUnique/findMany calls selecting revokedAt (one batched findMany counts once); logical auth lookup attempts, not PostgreSQL SQL statement count
measurement.tick: room step duration excludes gateway publish; scheduler execution includes step and synchronous publish; lateness = max(0, callback gap - 25ms)
measurement.database: isolated container cgroup v2 CPU cumulative usage and memory including page cache; samples bracket each phase; not process RSS
measurement.ack: input emit to acceptance ack; not tick application, rendered response, or WAN latency
measurement.inputs: 10 inputs/s/player, direction flips every second; 1 alternating melee/stone and 1 chat/s/player; no injected loss
measurement.memory: server and client RSS peak sampled every 100ms; no forced GC; retained RSS does not prove a leak
